status_note: Integration is complete (adapter, scripts, registry wiring, tests). The raw pull is not committed: the data.gov.in public demo API key is rate-limited to ~10 records/call and its quota was exhausted during integration. Populate with `python scripts/download_india_datasets.py` (slow on the demo key; <1 min with a free DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY from https://data.gov.in/user/register).
source_name: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India - data.gov.in
source: data.gov.in resource 35985678-0d79-46b4-9ed6-6f13308a1d24 ("Variety-wise Daily Market Prices Data of Commodity"); Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India; underlying system AGMARKNET
country_context: India - agricultural produce market committee (APMC / mandi) wholesale trade across multiple states. NOTE: this is wholesale commodity price data, not SME retail transactions.
business_domain: Agricultural commodity wholesale markets; daily min / max / modal price per commodity x market x variety
license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India), https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
citation: Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI), Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India. Variety-wise Daily Market Prices Data of Commodity [Data set]. Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India, data.gov.in. Retrieved via resource 35985678-0d79-46b4-9ed6-6f13308a1d24.
date_range: source spans 2006-present; the curated pull targets ~800 daily observations per series
unsupported_tasks: demand/quantity forecasting (source has NO quantity field)
SME retail representativeness (this is agri wholesale, not SME retail)

canonical_mapping.units_sold: REUSED SLOT - carries the daily MODAL PRICE (INR/quintal) being forecast; the source has no quantity field
canonical_mapping.price: 28-day backward rolling median of modal price, shifted 1 day (strictly past information - no leakage); leading rows fall back to the series' first modal price
canonical_mapping.marketing_spend: 0 - not present in source, not invented
canonical_mapping.promotion_flag: 0 - not present in source, not invented
canonical_mapping.modal_price/min_price/max_price: extra self-documenting columns; the trainer selects only the canonical columns

known_limitations: Wholesale agri-commodity prices, not SME retail transactions - do not present as representative of Indian SME retail.
No transaction quantity; this is a price-forecasting benchmark (units_sold slot reused for price).
Price series are near-random-walk, so the naive lag baseline is strong; report MAE/RMSE.
Demo API key rate limit makes the full historical pull slow; a free registered key removes the limit.
Curated to a fixed set of high-liquidity (commodity x market) series - not a national sample.
